origin.description: Run code inside a new directory, then delete it.

arguments.name: clean
arguments.text: Delete the directory afterwards when TRUE.

origin.details: clean = FALSE leaves the directory. The body runs with that directory as the working directory.

translation.description: Run code inside a new directory, then delete it.

arguments.name: clean
arguments.text: Delete the directory afterwards when TRUE.

translation.details: clean = FALSE leaves the directory. The body runs with that directory as the working directory. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

old = os.getcwd()
box = {}
def body():
    box["marker"] = os.getcwd()
    return os.path.basename(os.getcwd())
base = with_tempdir(body)
return [
    "back" if os.getcwd() == old else "moved",
    "gone" if not os.path.exists(box["marker"]) else "kept",
    "named" if base else "empty",
]
